notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.notes: The latest version fixes a bug where the game would crash when the player attempted to talk to the security guard.

notes.title: Version 0.3
notes.notes: The latest update now includes all talk text for the eight suspects to discuss each other, themselves and Zane.

notes.title: Version 0.2
notes.notes:
The latest update adds additional talk text. The eight suspects now have something to say about themselves and a few objects in addition to responses they already had about Zane.

Have fun!

notes.title: Version 0.1C
notes.notes:
Today's update removes the superfluous "TRAVEL" text after the player wins, loses or dies. Also, a spare room has been added to the second floor.

Be sure to post a comment in our discussion forum if you have any questions about playing the game, if you find a bug or if you'd like to suggest content.

Have fun!
